stories.title: Saudi air defenses intercept Houthi drone south of Makkah

en.title: Saudi air defenses intercept Houthi drone south of Makkah
en.summary: Saudi air defenses destroyed a Houthi drone south of Makkah on Tuesday evening before it could enter the city's restricted airspace. Coalition officials identified this as the second attempted attack on the holy city.

stories.title: Houthi drone destroyed before entering Makkah’s airspace, Saudi Arabia says

en.title: Houthi drone destroyed before entering Makkah's airspace, Saudi Arabia says
en.summary: Saudi air defenses destroyed a Houthi drone attempting to enter Makkah's airspace on Tuesday evening. A coalition spokesperson called the incident a serious escalation and warned of potential consequences.

stories.title: Arab League chief calls for immediate cessation of attacks targeting Saudi Arabia

en.title: Arab League chief calls for immediate cessation of attacks targeting Saudi Arabia
en.summary: The Arab League Secretary General condemned attacks on Saudi Arabia that caused injuries and damage, calling for their immediate end. He characterized the attacks as violations of Saudi sovereignty and a threat to regional stability.

stories.title: Egypt visit underscores strength of fraternal relations and shared desire: Crown Prince

en.title: Egypt visit underscores strength of fraternal relations and shared desire: Crown Prince
en.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman thanked Egyptian President El-Sisi following his working visit to Cairo. The Crown Prince highlighted the strong bilateral relations and shared objectives between the two nations.

stories.title: US Military Says It Destroyed 2 Small Iranian Boats Trying to Steal a Drone

en.title: US Military Says It Destroyed 2 Small Iranian Boats Trying to Steal a Drone
en.summary: The US military reported destroying two small Iranian boats that were attempting to steal a drone.

en.title: Arab Parliament Condemns Terrorist Houthi Militia Attacks on Saudi Arabia
en.summary: The Arab Parliament issued a condemnation of what it characterizes as terrorist attacks by the Houthi militia against Saudi Arabia.

en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince has arrived in Egypt for an official visit.

stories.title: Egypt Condemns Continued Attacks on Saudi Arabia

en.summary: Egypt issued a condemnation regarding ongoing attacks directed at Saudi Arabia.

en.summary: The Muslim World League condemned continuing attacks by the Houthi militia against Saudi Arabia.

en.summary: The Saudi Crown Prince began an official working visit to Egypt.

stories.title: 13 civilians injured in Houthi attacks on three Saudi cities

en.title: 13 civilians injured in Houthi attacks on three Saudi cities
en.summary: Houthi forces launched ballistic missiles and drones at civilian areas in Khamis Mushait, Abha, and Taif, resulting in 13 civilians with minor to moderate injuries and damage to seven homes and two vehicles.

stories.title: Saudi Crown Prince to pay visit to Egypt on Tuesday

en.title: Saudi Crown Prince to pay visit to Egypt on Tuesday
en.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman will visit Egypt for talks with President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi. The leaders plan to discuss strengthening bilateral relations and regional developments.

stories.title: ‎CMA caps overseas investments of money market funds at 5%

en.title: CMA caps overseas investments of money market funds at 5%
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Capital Market Authority has limited public money market fund investments outside the kingdom to 5% of net asset value, with all overseas investments requiring investment-grade credit ratings. Fund managers have up to two years to comply with the new requirement.

stories.title: ‎50 global hospitality operators enter Saudi Arabia since 2020

en.title: 50 global hospitality operators enter Saudi Arabia since 2020
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has attracted 50 international hospitality operators since 2020, with expectations to add approximately 200,000 hotel rooms by 2030 through roughly $120 billion in investments. The sector aims to enhance competitiveness and visitor experience.

stories.title: ‎NDMC closes September sukuk issuance at SAR 1.6B

en.title: NDMC closes September sukuk issuance at SAR 1.6B
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's National Debt Management Center concluded its September sukuk issuance at 1.64 billion Saudi riyals, divided into six tranches with varying maturity dates ranging from 2029 to 2033.

en.title: Tadawul: Major ownership changes on Sept. 13
en.summary: Significant ownership changes are scheduled to occur on the Saudi stock exchange on September 13.

stories.title: ‎SAMA starts Mada, Himyan cards acceptance in Qatar, Saudi Arabia

en.title: SAMA starts Mada, Himyan cards acceptance in Qatar, Saudi Arabia
en.summary: The Saudi and Qatar central banks are implementing mutual acceptance of their national payment cards across both countries to strengthen regional payment integration.
